question:
Select the option that rectifies the spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The children were excited to ride the __carusel__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"carusel"** is incorrect and needs to be rectified. 
 
• **Carusel** is not a recognized English word and thus has no meaning. 
 
 
• **Example:** The children were excited to ride the carusel. (Incorrect sentence)
 
 
 
• **"Carousel"** refers to a rotating machine or device, often at amusement parks, where people ride on seats or animals that go up and down. (झूला)
 
 
• **Example:** The children were excited to ride the carousel at the amusement park.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Carousell** (कोई अर्थ नहीं): This is an incorrect spelling and does not have any meaning.

 
 
• **Example:** The children were excited to ride the carousell. (Incorrect sentence)
 
 
 
• **Carrousel** (झूला): An alternative but less common spelling of "carousel".
 
 
• **Example:** The children were excited to ride the carrousel at the amusement park.
 
 
 
• **Karusel** (कोई अर्थ नहीं): This is an incorrect spelling and does not have any meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** The children were excited to ride the karusel. (Incorrect sentence)
